name: update-status-missing-serverversion
description: NEGATIVE (D-05, protocol 1.8, SPEC §1 and §7): update.status carrying only `extConnected` must be a hard decode error — `serverVersion` is required and is never defaulted. A silently-absent serverVersion would make the phone's version comparison run against nothing, and "unknown" must never be treated as newer (D-26); the decoder refuses the frame instead.
